>

</title>

<traits>

<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=564" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 119

**Price** 4 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><row>[Cast a Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734) (add 1 action)</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A small bundle of _[wolliped](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1369) fleece_ contains the memory of winter snows. Adding this catalyst to a casting of [_chilling spray_](/Spells.aspx?ID=678) coats all squares within the area of effect with a thin layer of ice. These squares become [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) until the beginning of your next turn.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
